description: Pcat: the Tn9 cat (chloramphenicol acetyltransferase) promoter, 78 bp (V00622 140-217).

references.title: Nucleotide sequence analysis of the chloramphenicol resistance transposon Tn9.

references.authors: González-Prieto C, Agúndez L, Llosa M
references.title: Chloramphenicol Selection of IS10 Transposition in the cat Promoter Region of Widely Used Cloning Vectors.

label: Pcat
note: Promoter of the Tn9 cat gene, taken from V00622 (Alton and Vapnek 1979) 140-217. Both ends are provisional: no accessible source maps the transcription start or the -35/-10 of this promoter. The 5' end is set one base earlier than the window this part carried before, so that the TTGACA-like hexamer TTGATC at V00622 140-145 — a -35 by consensus, not by mapping — is whole. The 3' end stops 27 bp before the cat start codon: González-Prieto et al. 2015 report an IS10 target (TACCGGGCG, bases 52-60 here) 22 bp downstream of the promoter's -10 element and 53 bp upstream of the cat ATG, which places the -10 around V00622 163-169 and leaves the Shine-Dalgarno region, and the catalog part RBS 23400, outside this window. The 103 bp this part carried before ran to the ATG and overlapped RBS 23400 on 228 plasmids of a 1,390-plasmid collection. The -35 and -10 boxes below are the pair that carries the canonical 17 bp spacing (ACGTAA at 10-15, CATAAT at 33-38, 1-based), which is also the pair older automated annotations mark on cat-carrying vectors. They are placed by consensus, not mapped: a second reading of the distance González-Prieto et al. report would put the -10 nine bases earlier, with TTGATC at 1-6 as the -35. Both readings are provisional.

label: Pcat -35
note: Sigma-70 -35 box (ACGTAA), 17 bp upstream of the -10 below. Placed by consensus and by the annotation that circulates on cat-carrying vectors; not mapped experimentally in an accessible source.

label: Pcat -10
note: Sigma-70 -10 box (CATAAT), the better consensus match of the two candidate pairs in this window. Placed by consensus; not mapped experimentally in an accessible source.

provenance.sequence_source: V00622 (Tn9 cat gene, Alton and Vapnek 1979), positions 140-217, 100% over 78 bp; both boundaries provisional
